## Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-17T11:18Z

The question in this card's 维护者速读 (may skills-eval scores enter an `eval-run` record in this repository) was put to the maintainer on a decision card in seat 3's thread, fable-reviewed first, recommendation A. The maintainer chose, verbatim: 「A 进本仓带全分,同场景卡」.

Execution, read by the dev and L1: a skills round's `eval-run` record in this repository carries the full scores, the same as a scenario-card round. The charter line this card adds to `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md` says so in the same terms `eval.md:34` uses for scenario cards (no issue number, date or quotation in the skill text). Nothing else in the card changes.

The first round ran on this container's subscription login: 209 cases × 2 arms × 1 rep = 418 turns, all of which ran. The record with full scores is #34842 (`eval-run`); the runner is draft PR #34841.

- **Time**: 56.1 min with 4 turns at once. The median turn took 30 s with the skill and 24 s without. Claude Code 2.1.326, login `oauth_token`, no API key, served `claude-opus-5-5`.
- **Cost**: 71.24 USD notional as the CLI reported it (nothing billed). The login's seven-day utilization went from 0.45 to 0.56.

| bundle | cases | with-skill | no-skill | with-skill failing |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| objectstack-ai | 8 | 5/8 | 1/8 | 3 |
| objectstack-api | 7 | 4/7 | 0/7 | 3 |
| objectstack-automation | 26 | 19/26 | 2/26 | 7 |
| objectstack-data | 44 | 28/44 | 3/44 | 16 |
| objectstack-formula | 12 | 10/12 | 1/12 | 2 |
| objectstack-i18n | 11 | 8/11 | 0/11 | 3 |
| objectstack-platform | 23 | 18/23 | 2/23 | 5 |
| objectstack-query | 8 | 5/8 | 1/8 | 3 |
| objectstack-ui | 31 | 23/31 | 4/31 | 8 |
| objectstack-upgrade | 5 | 2/5 | 0/5 | 3 |
| objectui | 34 | 22/34 | 6/34 | 12 |
| **all** | 209 | 144/209 (69%) | 20/209 (10%) | 65 |

The no-skill arm scored at least as high as the with-skill arm on 83 cases: 2 where no-skill passed and with-skill failed, 18 where both passed, and 63 where both failed. The `objectui` with-skill verdicts come from `--regrade`: the runner's first arm check misread a `user-invocable: false` bundle, and the record's Reading 4 has the details. The record stays open so the seat can route the 65 with-skill failures.

- **Reviews:** L1 ACCEPT 6950349685 (S1 fixed in round 2), delta ACCEPT 6952635977 at `bd40928d`, no open finding. No seat L2 owed (`Clause-②: no`).
- **Still owed by this card:** the `eval.md` charter line, which is seat 3's own Tier S PR per the card body. The card stays open for it. `lease:o3-F` leaves with this comment; the runner side has nothing left.
